constraint1:
Constraint 1: Assign each operation of every job to exactly one of its eligible machines.
Constraint 2: Operations within each job must follow their prescribed processing order.
Constraint 3: A machine may process only one operation at a time; operations on the same machine must not overlap.
Constraint 4: The makespan must be at least the completion time of every job.
Constraint 5: All operation start times must be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 1 must not begin processing before time 500; starting exactly at 500 is allowed.
Constraint 7: Job 2 must be completed no later than time 2000, including completion at 2000.
Constraint 8: To allow natural cooling and curing after adhesive application, the waiting interval from the completion of an operation to the start of the next operation must be between 25 and 55 time units for every job, inclusive.
formula1: \begin{equation}25 \leq B_{i,j+1} - \left( B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} \left( pt_{i,j,k} X_{i,j,k} \right) \right) \leq 55, \forall i \in I, j \in \{1,2,...,n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 6)
code1:
# Constraint 6: Job 1 must not begin processing before time 500; starting exactly at 500 is allowed.
    model.addConstr(B[0, 0] >= 500, name="start_time_lower_bound_1")

# Constraint 6: Job 2 must be completed no later than time 2000, including completion at 2000.
    model.addConstr(B[1, OpNum[1]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[1, OpNum[1]-1, k] * X[1, OpNum[1]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[1, OpNum[1]-1][k] > 0) <= 2000, name="job2_completion_ub")

constraint2:
Constraint 1: Every operation must be allocated to one and only one compatible machine.
Constraint 2: For each job, an operation may start only after its preceding operation has finished.
Constraint 3: Operations assigned to a common machine must be scheduled without overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: The overall completion time cannot be smaller than any individual job's completion time.
Constraint 5: No operation is allowed to start before time zero.
Constraint 6: The start of Job 2 must be scheduled no later than time 200, including 200.
Constraint 7: To meet the delivery timing requirement, Job 3 must finish at or after time 400.
Constraint 8: To allow surface drying after electroplating, each job must wait at least 15 time units between consecutive operations. A waiting interval of exactly 15 is permitted.
formula2: \begin{equation}B_{i,j+1} \geq B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} \left( pt_{i,j,k} X_{i,j,k} \right) + 15, \forall i \in I, j \in \{1,2,...,n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 7)
code2:
# Constraint 7: The start of Job 2 must be scheduled no later than time 200, including 200.
    model.addConstr(B[1, 0] <= 200, name="start_time_upper_bound_2")

# Constraint 7: To meet the delivery timing requirement, Job 3 must finish at or after time 400.
    model.addConstr(B[2, OpNum[2]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[2, OpNum[2]-1, k] * X[2, OpNum[2]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[2, OpNum[2]-1][k] > 0) >= 400, name="job3_completion_lb")

constraint3:
Constraint 1: Select exactly one machine from the eligible set for each operation of each job.
Constraint 2: Respect the specified precedence sequence among the operations of a job.
Constraint 3: On any given machine, processing intervals of different operations must be mutually exclusive.
Constraint 4: The makespan must cover the completion of all jobs.
Constraint 5: The start time of every operation must be greater than or equal to zero.
Constraint 6: Job 3 must start within the time window from 500 to 600, with both endpoints included.
Constraint 7: The completion time of Job 4 must fall between 1400 and 1500, inclusive.
Constraint 8: To allow sufficient aging and stabilization after injection molding, the waiting interval between consecutive operations of every job must be at least 30 and at most 60 time units, including both endpoints.
formula3: \begin{equation}30 \leq B_{i,j+1} - \left( B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} \left( pt_{i,j,k} X_{i,j,k} \right) \right) \leq 60, \forall i \in I, j \in \{1,2,...,n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 8)
code3:
# Constraint 8: Job 3 must start within the time window from 500 to 600, with both endpoints included.
    model.addConstr(B[2, 0] >= 500, name="start_time_lower_bound_3")
    model.addConstr(B[2, 0] <= 600, name="start_time_upper_bound_3")

# Constraint 8: The completion time of Job 4 must fall between 1400 and 1500, inclusive.
    model.addConstr(B[3, OpNum[3]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] * X[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[3, OpNum[3]-1][k] > 0) >= 1400, name="job4_completion_range_lb")
    model.addConstr(B[3, OpNum[3]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] * X[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[3, OpNum[3]-1][k] > 0) <= 1500, name="job4_completion_range_ub")

constraint4:
Constraint 1: Each job operation is to be processed on exactly one machine capable of performing it.
Constraint 2: A job's operations must be processed in the required order, with each predecessor completed before its successor starts.
Constraint 3: Each machine has unit capacity and cannot process two operations simultaneously.
Constraint 4: The makespan cannot precede the finishing time of any job.
Constraint 5: Operation start times are restricted to zero or later.
Constraint 6: The earliest permitted start time for Job 4 is 750; it may begin exactly at 750.
Constraint 7: Job 5 must finish by time 1500; completion exactly at 1500 is acceptable.
Constraint 8: For dimensional stability following precision machining, the waiting interval between consecutive operations of every job must not exceed 40 time units. Waiting exactly 40 is allowed.
formula4: \begin{equation}B_{i,j+1} \leq B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} \left( pt_{i,j,k} X_{i,j,k} \right) + 40, \forall i \in I, j \in \{1,2,...,n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 6)
code4:
# Constraint 7: The earliest permitted start time for Job 4 is 750; it may begin exactly at 750.
    model.addConstr(B[3, 0] >= 750, name="start_time_lower_bound_4")

# Constraint 9: Job 5 must finish by time 1500; completion exactly at 1500 is acceptable.
    model.addConstr(B[4, OpNum[4]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[4, OpNum[4]-1, k] * X[4, OpNum[4]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[4, OpNum[4]-1][k] > 0) <= 1500, name="job5_completion_ub")

constraint5:
Constraint 1: For every operation, choose one eligible machine and assign the operation to that machine alone.
Constraint 2: All operations belonging to the same job must satisfy the given precedence relationships.
Constraint 3: Any two operations processed by the same machine must have non-overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: Every job must finish no later than the makespan.
Constraint 5: Starting an operation at a negative time is prohibited.
Constraint 6: Job 5 must begin processing by time 300. A start at 300 satisfies this requirement.
Constraint 7: To satisfy the material delivery timing requirement, Job 6 must not finish before time 1600. Completion at 1600 is allowed.
Constraint 8: To allow rinsing and draining after anodizing, the waiting interval between consecutive operations of every job must satisfy both a minimum of 20 and a maximum of 50 time units. Both boundary values are permitted.
formula5: \begin{equation}20 \leq B_{i,j+1} - \left( B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} \left( pt_{i,j,k} X_{i,j,k} \right) \right) \leq 50, \forall i \in I, j \in \{1,2,...,n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 7)
code5:
# Constraint 8: Job 5 must begin processing by time 300. A start at 300 satisfies this requirement.
    model.addConstr(B[4, 0] <= 300, name="start_time_upper_bound_5")

# Constraint 10: To satisfy the material delivery timing requirement, Job 6 must not finish before time 1600. Completion at 1600 is allowed.
    model.addConstr(B[5, OpNum[5]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[5, OpNum[5]-1, k] * X[5, OpNum[5]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[5, OpNum[5]-1][k] > 0) >= 1600, name="job6_completion_lb")

constraint6:
Constraint 1: Each operation must receive exactly one assignment among its compatible machines.
Constraint 2: Within a job, the next operation cannot begin until the previous operation is complete.
Constraint 3: Machine processing must be sequential: no two operations on a machine may run at the same time.
Constraint 4: The makespan is required to be no less than the finishing time of each job.
Constraint 5: The earliest permissible start time for any operation is zero.
Constraint 6: The start time of Job 6 must lie between 400 and 550, inclusive.
Constraint 7: Job 7 must complete within the time window from 1750 to 1850, including both endpoints.
Constraint 8: To allow cooling after heat treatment, the waiting interval between consecutive operations of Job 2 must be no less than 30 and no greater than 60 time units, inclusive.
formula6: \begin{equation}30 \leq B_{2,j+1} - \left( B_{2,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{2,j}} \left( pt_{2,j,k} X_{2,j,k} \right) \right) \leq 60, \forall j \in \{1,2,...,n_2-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 8)

    model.addConstr(B[5, 0] >= 400, name="start_time_lower_bound_6")
    model.addConstr(B[5, 0] <= 550, name="start_time_upper_bound_6")

# Constraint 11: Job 7 must complete within the time window from 1750 to 1850, including both endpoints.
    model.addConstr(B[6, OpNum[6]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[6, OpNum[6]-1, k] * X[6, OpNum[6]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[6, OpNum[6]-1][k] > 0) >= 1750, name="job7_completion_range_lb")
    model.addConstr(B[6, OpNum[6]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[6, OpNum[6]-1, k] * X[6, OpNum[6]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[6, OpNum[6]-1][k] > 0) <= 1850, name="job7_completion_range_ub")

# Constraint 8: To allow cooling after heat treatment, the waiting interval between consecutive operations of Job 2 must be no less than 30 and no greater than 60 time units, inclusive.
    for j in range(OpNum[1] - 1):
        model.addConstr(B[1, j + 1] >= B[1, j] + quicksum(pt_table[1, j, k] * X[1, j, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[1][j][k] > 0) + 30, name=f"job2_wait_lb({j})")
        model.addConstr(B[1, j + 1] <= B[1, j] + quicksum(pt_table[1, j, k] * X[1, j, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[1][j][k] > 0) + 60, name=f"job2_wait_ub({j})")

Constraint 5: Every operation must have a start time of at least zero.
Constraint 6: Job 7 cannot start earlier than time 800, but a start at 800 is permitted.
Constraint 7: To meet the preceding-process coordination requirement, Job 8 must finish no later than time 1700, with equality permitted.

constraint10:

Constraint 2: Maintain the required processing sequence for each job, ensuring that consecutive operations satisfy finish-to-start precedence.
Constraint 3: Schedule operations on each machine one at a time, with no overlap in their processing intervals.
Constraint 4: The makespan must not be less than the completion time of any job in the schedule.
Constraint 5: Require a nonnegative start time for every operation.
Constraint 6: Every job must start no earlier than time 20. Starting exactly at 20 is allowed.
Constraint 7: All jobs must be completed by time 2000, including completion at 2000.
Constraint 8: For the polishing pretreatment of customized parts, the waiting interval from the completion of each operation of Job 6 to the start of its next operation must be at least 15 and at most 30 time units. Both endpoints are allowed, providing suitable conditions for subsequent precision machining.
formula10: \begin{equation}15 \leq B_{6,j+1} - \left( B_{6,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{6,j}} pt_{6,j,k} X_{6,j,k} \right) \leq 30, \quad \forall j \in \{1,2,...,n_6-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 8)
